verdict.rationale: Manufact mentions a 'Chat' feature for testing MCP servers and a 'built-in autofix flow' that can automatically fix compliance issues, which are narrow forms of delegating tasks to an in-product AI capability, but there is no evidence of a general-purpose built-in AI assistant for broader task delegation across the platform. Missing for 10: a documented general AI assistant/agent persona, scope of tasks it can perform beyond autofix/chat testing, and independent corroboration of its effectiveness.
